interface.name: gnoblin_view_source_manager_v1
interface.description:
Offered only on the owner's privileged socket, the one the session's own processes connect on. An application's connection never sees this global, so no application can read a View's pixels through it.
A source names one View node of the tree by its node id. A capture session on that source yields the View's picture at the View's size, in the same formats and on the same copy path as an output capture. The picture is redelivered when the View redraws. `capture{cursor}` has no effect on a View, which has no cursor.
A capture of a View is refused while the session is locked, exactly as an output capture is.

entry.name: invalid_node
entry.summary: the node is unknown or is not a View

request.name: create_source

description.summary: create a capture source for a View node

request.description: Creates an ext_image_capture_source_v1 that names the View node with the given id. The node must be a View that exists in the tree when the request arrives; otherwise the client gets an invalid_node protocol error.

arg.name: node
arg.summary: the node id of a View

request.name: destroy
request.description: Sources already created stay valid until they are destroyed themselves.
